"""Invoices."""

import re

from shop.orders import new_order


def _reference(prefix, number, customer):
    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", customer.lower()).strip("-")
    if not slug:
        slug = "anonymous"
    if len(slug) > 12:
        slug = slug[:12].rstrip("-")
    return f"{prefix}-{number:06d}-{slug}"


def invoice_for(order, number, due_days=30):
    return {
        "reference": _reference("INV", number, order["customer"]),
        "order": order["reference"],
        "amount_due": order["total"],
        "due_days": due_days,
    }


def quick_invoice(number, customer, amount):
    order = new_order(number, customer, [("misc", 1, amount)])
    return invoice_for(order, number, due_days=14)
